description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer
experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Joint Mobile Engineering Team (JMET) is an unusual security engineering group within Apple’s Information Systems and
Technology Group. We provide critical services for the company across every product line. From manufacturing to customer
facing, our services span across the entire lifecycle of most Apple hardware. We are responsible to design, implement and
support the ongoing need to improve customer safety and privacy by providing security services that are tightly coupled with
hardware.

Many of our services are seen in Apple Platform Security documentation or publicly discussed on internet forums. As an
engineer, you will participate in initiatives that are important to the success of upcoming product launches and product security
initiatives. You will also work with large cross functional teams to align the expectations and validate work you're doing.

Description
We are looking for a motivated and talented experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to own the design
and implementation of the quality assurance process, ensuring the delivery of high quality software products in a distributed
environment.

Responsibilities
In this role, you will drive quality and quality-related development work in all team projects.
You will work alongside the software development and SRE teams to acquire in-depth knowledge of how each application works in terms of business logic, security aspects, development environments, and production environments. 
You will design, implement and maintain automation roadmap for complex services, while also driving advancements in functional validation and test strategies.

Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science or equivalent
3+ years of experience in relevant fields
Strong software engineering foundation with hands-on proficiency in Java and C, and working knowledge of Bash, and
scripting for QE tooling; experienced with REST API testing, relational and NoSQL databases, and the ability to review
software architecture for testability and maintainability.
Deep understanding of security and embedded systems concepts including PKI, X.509, ASN.1, key exchange and
authentication protocols, with solid experience working in Unix/Linux environments
Experienced in designing and building test automation frameworks for cryptographic components across unit,
integration, and system levels using TestNG, JMeter, XCTest or equivalent tools.
Strong QE methodology knowledge with a solid grasp of SDLC best practices, CI/CD concepts, and the ability to build
and maintain automation for complex full-stack applications.
Skilled debugger and problem solver with strong root cause analysis capabilities across both hardware and software
layers.
Self-motivated and detail-oriented with strong written and verbal communication skills and a proven ability to manage
priorities across concurrent release cycles.

Preferred qualifications
Up-to-date with current and up-coming QE technologies and frameworks
Experience contributing to or reviewing threat models and security test plans covering functional business use cases
Understanding of cryptographic module validation testing
Experience with performance and scalability testing
Passion for driving quality into every aspect of a project
Ability to work with cross functional and globally distributed teams
Familiar with Agile workflow management
